u0: Safe, compliant state: the agent has not simultaneously carried the matching door key and had the blocking ball moved away from the door. It may hold the key only while the ball still blocks the door, or have moved the ball while not carrying the key, including after dropping or losing the key. Continue the mission while preserving this separation: do not pick up the matching key while blocker_moved is true, and do not move the blocker while holding that key. This is the only acceptable final state for the constraint; if the ball is dropped back in front of the door, blocker_moved becomes false and compliant progress can continue.
u1: Forbidden, absorbing failure state: the matching door key has been carried while the blocking ball was moved away from the door, so the constraint has been violated and the entry penalty has been incurred. The state remains active even if the key is later dropped or lost, or if the ball is returned to the door; there is no recovery back to u0. The agent can only continue the underlying episode after this safety failure.
